title: codemode.yaml
description: How protoc-gen-codemode exposes an API to Code Mode. Every key is optional.

include.description: Service full-name globs to expose, e.g. library.v1.*. Default: all.

naming.description: Sandbox method names: library.createBook or library.create_book.

destructive.description: Whether destructive methods pause for approval.

elicitation.description: Whether methods with mcp.v1.elicitation pause for approval.

infer_from_aip.description: Treat unannotated Delete*, Purge* and Remove* methods as destructive.

discovery.description: progressive: namespaces in the tool description, types through describe(). inline: every type in the description.

import_extension.description: Extension on relative imports: .ts for Node, Bun and Deno; .js for compiled output; empty for bundlers.

runtime_prefix.description: Prefix of the runtime-ts package names; generated code imports <prefix>protobuf, <prefix>network and <prefix>codemode.

timeout.description: Deadline for each sandbox pass, as a Go duration.

allow.description: Hosts reachable when outbound is allowlist.
